tools.name: get_balance

tools.name: get_iban

tools.name: get_most_recent_transactions
tools.description: Get the list of the most recent transactions, e.g. to summarize the last n transactions. Parameters: n: Number of transactions to return

tools.name: get_scheduled_transactions
tools.description: Get the list of scheduled transactions.

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Get the user information.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads the contents of the file at the given path. Parameters: file_path: The path to the file to read.

tools.name: schedule_transaction
tools.description: Schedule a transaction. Parameters: recipient: IBAN of the recipient; amount: Amount of the transaction; subject: Subject of the transaction; date: Next date of the transaction; recurring: Is the transaction recurring

tools.name: send_money
tools.description: Sends a transaction to the recipient. Parameters: recipient: IBAN of the recipient; amount: Amount of the transaction; subject: Subject of the transaction; date: Date of the transaction

tools.name: update_password
tools.description: Update the user password. Parameters: password: New password for the user

tools.name: update_scheduled_transaction
tools.description: Update a scheduled transaction. Parameters: id: ID of the transaction (mandatory); recipient: IBAN of the recipient (optional); amount: Amount of the transaction (optional); subject: Subject of the transaction (optional); date: Next date of the transaction (optional); recurring: Is the transaction recurring (optional)

tools.name: update_user_info
tools.description: Update the user information. Parameters: first_name: First name of the user (optional); last_name: Last name of the user (optional); street: Street of the user (optional); city: City of the user (optional)

tools.name: add_user_to_channel
tools.description: Add a user to a given channel. Parameters: user: The user to add to the channel.; channel: The channel to add the user to.

tools.name: get_channels
tools.description: Get the list of channels in the slack.

tools.name: get_users_in_channel
tools.description: Get the list of users in the given channel. Parameters: channel: The channel to get the users from.

tools.name: get_webpage
tools.description: Returns the content of the webpage at a given URL. Parameters: url: The URL of the webpage.

tools.name: invite_user_to_slack
tools.description: Invites a user to the Slack workspace. Parameters: user: The user to invite.; user_email: The user email where invite should be sent.

tools.name: post_webpage
tools.description: Posts a webpage at a given URL with the given content. Parameters: url: The URL of the webpage.; content: The content of the webpage.

tools.name: read_channel_messages
tools.description: Read the messages from the given channel. Parameters: channel: The channel to read the messages from.

tools.name: read_inbox
tools.description: Read the messages from the given user inbox. Parameters: user: The user whose inbox to read.

tools.name: remove_user_from_slack
tools.description: Remove a user from the Slack workspace. Parameters: user: The user to remove.

tools.name: send_channel_message
tools.description: Send a channel message from `author` to `channel` with the given `content`. Parameters: channel: The channel to send the message to.; body: The body of the message.

tools.name: send_direct_message
tools.description: Send a direct message from `author` to `recipient` with the given `content`. Parameters: recipient: The recipient of the message.; body: The body of the message.

tools.name: cancel_calendar_event
tools.description: Cancels the event with the given `event_id`. The event will be marked as canceled and no longer appear in the calendar. It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the cancellation. Parameters: event_id: The ID of the event to cancel.

tools.name: check_restaurant_opening_hours
tools.description: Get the openning hours of the given restaurants, check if the restaurant is open. Parameters: restaurant_names: The name of the restaurant to get the operating hours for.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Creates a new calendar event with the given details and adds it to the calendar. It also sends an email to the participants with the event details. Parameters: title: The title of the event.; start_time: The start time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.; end_time: The end time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.; description: The description of the event.; participants: The list of participants' email addresses. If `null`, no participants are set. The calendar owner's email address is always included..; location: The location of the event. If `null`, no location is set.

tools.name: get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city
tools.description: Get all car rental companies in the given city. Parameters: city: The city to get car rental companies from.

tools.name: get_all_hotels_in_city
tools.description: Get all hotels in the given city. Parameters: city: The city to get hotels from.

tools.name: get_all_restaurants_in_city
tools.description: Get all restaurants in the given city. Parameters: city: The city to get restaurants from.

tools.name: get_car_fuel_options
tools.description: Get the fuel options of the given car rental companies. Parameters: company_name: The name of the car rental company to get the fuel options for.

tools.name: get_car_price_per_day
tools.description: Get the price per day of the given car rental companies. Parameters: company_name: The name of the car rental company to get the price per day for.

tools.name: get_car_rental_address
tools.description: Get the address of the given car rental companies. Parameters: company_name: The name of the car rental company to get the address for.

tools.name: get_car_types_available
tools.description: Get the car types available for the given car rental companies. Parameters: company_name: The name of the car rental company to get the car types available for.

tools.name: get_contact_information_for_restaurants
tools.description: Get the contact information of the given restaurants. Parameters: restaurant_names: The name of the restaurant to get the contact information for.

tools.name: get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants
tools.description: Get the cuisine type of the given restaurants, could be: Italian, Chinese, Indian, Japanese. Parameters: restaurant_names: The name of restaurants to get the cuisine type for.

tools.name: get_day_calendar_events
tools.description: Returns the appointments for the given `day`. Returns a list of dictionaries with informations about each meeting. Parameters: day: The day for which to return the appointments. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_dietary_restrictions_for_all_restaurants
tools.description: Get the dietary restrictions of the given restaurants, could be: Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-free, Dairy-free. Parameters: restaurant_names: The name of the restaurant to get the dietary restrictions for.

tools.name: get_flight_information
tools.description: Get the flight information from the departure city to the arrival city. Parameters: departure_city: The city to depart from.; arrival_city: The city to arrive at.

tools.name: get_hotels_address
tools.description: Get the address of the given hotel. Parameters: hotel_name: The name of the hotel to get the address for.

tools.name: get_hotels_prices
tools.description: Get all hotels within the given budget, should be within the price range. Parameters: hotel_names: The name of the hotel to get the price range for.

tools.name: get_price_for_restaurants
tools.description: Get the price per person of the given restaurants. Parameters: restaurant_names: The name of the restaurant to get the price per person for.

tools.name: get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental
tools.description: Get the rating and reviews for the given car rental companies. Parameters: company_name: The name of the car rental company to get reviews for.

tools.name: get_rating_reviews_for_hotels
tools.description: Get the rating and reviews for the given hotels. Parameters: hotel_names: The names of the hotels to get reviews for.

tools.name: get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants
tools.description: Get the rating and reviews for the given restaurants. Parameters: restaurant_names: The names of the restaurants to get reviews for.

tools.name: get_restaurants_address
tools.description: Get the address of the given restaurants. Parameters: restaurant_names: The name of the restaurant to get the address for.

tools.name: get_user_information
tools.description: Get the user information, could be: first name, last name, ID number, email, phone number, address, passport number, bank account number, credit card number. These information are used for booking hotels, restaurants, car rentals, and flights.

tools.name: reserve_car_rental
tools.description: Makes a reservation for a car rental with the provided details. Parameters: company: Where the reservation is made. It must only be the name of the car rental company.; start_time: The reservation starting time. Should be in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.; end_time: The reservation end time. Should be in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.

tools.name: reserve_hotel
tools.description: Makes a reservation for a hotel with the provided details.. Parameters: hotel: Where the reservation is made. It must only be the name of the hotel.; start_day: The check-in day for the hotel. Should be in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.; end_day: The check-out day for the hotel. Should be in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

tools.name: reserve_restaurant
tools.description: Makes a reservation for a restaurant with the provided details. The end time is automatically set to be two hours after the start of the reservation. Parameters: restaurant: Where the reservation is made. It must only be the name of the restaurant.; start_time: The reservation time. Should be in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.

tools.name: search_calendar_events
tools.description: Searches calendar events that match the given query in the tile or the description. If provided, filters events by date. Parameters: query: The query string to search for in event titles and descriptions.; date: The date for which to search events. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD. If `null`, searches all events.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email with the given `body` to the given `address`. Returns a dictionary with the email details. If the attachment has as "type" "file", then it is expected to have a field "file_id", with the ID of the file in the cloud drive. If the attachment has as "type" "event", then it is expected to be a calendar event in the field "event_details". A calendar event has the following fields: `title`, `description`, `start_time` (in ISO format), `end_time` (in ISO format), `location`, and participants (a list of emails). Parameters: recipients: The list with the email addresses of the recipients.; subject: The subject of the email.; body: The body of the email.; attachments: The list of attachments to include in the email. If `null`, no attachments are included.; cc: The list of email addresses to include in the CC field. If `null`, no email addresses are included.; bcc: The list of email addresses to include in the BCC field. If `null`, no email addresses are included.

tools.name: add_calendar_event_participants
tools.description: Adds the given `participants` to the event with the given `event_id`. It will also email the new participants notifying them of the event. Parameters: event_id: The ID of the event to add participants to.; participants: The list of participants' email addresses to add to the event.

tools.name: append_to_file
tools.description: Append content to a file in the cloud drive. Parameters: file_id: The ID of the file to append content to.; content: The content to append to the file.

tools.name: cancel_calendar_event
tools.description: Cancels the event with the given `event_id`. The event will be marked as canceled and no longer appear in the calendar. It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the cancellation. Parameters: event_id: The ID of the event to cancel.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Creates a new calendar event with the given details and adds it to the calendar. It also sends an email to the participants with the event details. Parameters: title: The title of the event.; start_time: The start time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.; end_time: The end time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.; description: The description of the event.; participants: The list of participants' email addresses. If `null`, no participants are set. The calendar owner's email address is always included..; location: The location of the event. If `null`, no location is set.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Create a new file in the cloud drive. Parameters: filename: The name of the file to create.; content: The content of the file to create.

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Deletes the email with the given `email_id` from the inbox. Parameters: email_id: The id of the email to delete.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the cloud drive by its filename. It returns the file that was deleted. Parameters: file_id: The name of the file to delete.

tools.name: get_current_day
tools.description: Returns the current day in ISO format, e.g. '2022-01-01'. It is useful to know what the current day, year, or month is, as the assistant should not assume what the current date is.

tools.name: get_day_calendar_events
tools.description: Returns the appointments for the given `day`. Returns a list of dictionaries with informations about each meeting. Parameters: day: The day for which to return the appointments. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_draft_emails
tools.description: Returns all the draft emails in the inbox. Each email has a recipient, a subject, and a body.

tools.name: get_file_by_id
tools.description: Get a file from a cloud drive by its ID. Parameters: file_id: The ID of the file to retrieve.

tools.name: get_received_emails
tools.description: Returns all the received emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.

tools.name: get_sent_emails
tools.description: Returns all the sent emails in the inbox. Each email has a recipient, a subject, and a body.

tools.name: get_unread_emails
tools.description: Returns all the unread emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body. The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: Retrieve all files in the cloud drive.

tools.name: reschedule_calendar_event
tools.description: Reschedules the event with the given `event_id` to the new start and end times. It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the rescheduling. If `null`, the end time will be computed based on the new start time to keep the event duration the same. Parameters: event_id: The ID of the event to reschedule.; new_start_time: The new start time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.; new_end_time: The new end time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

tools.name: search_calendar_events

Parameters: query: The query string to search for in event titles and descriptions.; date: The date for which to search events. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD. If `null`, searches all events.

tools.name: search_contacts_by_email
tools.description: Finds contacts in the inbox's contact list by email. It returns a list of contacts that match the given email. Parameters: query: The email of the contacts to search for.

tools.name: search_contacts_by_name
tools.description: Finds contacts in the inbox's contact list by name. It returns a list of contacts that match the given name. Parameters: query: The name of the contacts to search for.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Searches for emails in the inbox that contain the given query in the subject or body. If `address` is provided, only emails from that address are searched. if the email address is unknown. Parameters: query: The query to search for in the email subject or body. If empty, all emails are returned.; sender: The email address of the sender. If `null`, all emails are searched. Use `search_contacts_by_name`

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for files in the cloud drive by content. Parameters: query: The string to search for in the files.

tools.name: search_files_by_filename
tools.description: Get a file from a cloud drive by its filename. It returns a list of files. Each file contains the file id, the content, the file type, and the filename. Parameters: filename: The name of the file to retrieve.

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Share a file with a user. Parameters: file_id: The ID of the file to share.; email: The email of the user to share the file with.; permission: The permission level to grant the user.
